title: Quiet Presence
question: Can independent work streams remain present and recoverable while the Owner keeps sovereignty over attention — free to ignore, enter deeply, leave, and return without catch-up debt?
laws_under_test: value may be local rather than globally ranked
artifacts may migrate without first-context rejection becoming a verdict
participants may create local affordances instead of only consuming platform features
attention_posture: attention has a cost, but not every chosen cost is burden
the medium must not spend the Owner's attention on their behalf
deep voluntary participation is success, not a failure to minimize attention
leaving or ignoring something must not create mandatory catch-up debt
